== Passive Ability: Transcending Heavenly Pressure ==
Enemies that are hit by '''Illusionist (Transcended)''' that are '''25%''' health or lower (not including bosses) are set into a '''fragile state''', which leaves them one hit to anything.

* Note: Enemies with purple health bars will say "Fragile" on it and have a text in full black saying "SHATTERED" when this is activates. 
== Active Ability: Beyond the Heavens ==
[[File:TrancendedAbilityIcon.png|left|thumb|80x80px]]
On placement, Illusionist (Transcended) is given this ability that makes all enemies on the map (Including bosses) are stunned for 5 seconds whilst any enemy 35% health or lower to a fragile state. 

* Note: Boss enemies that give themselves hyper armor (Like martial boss that gives itself a speed boost and regen) Or a buff might be unaffected by the ability.

* Ability Cooldown is 6 minutes.

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
==Trivia==
*Illusionist (Transcended) is the second most expensive unit in the game, only second to [[Usurper (Founder)]].
*Illusionist (Transcended)'s shiny appearance is based on a fanart by [https://x.com/AlbedoBlender/status/1510611236832129032 BE023], which can be found in X (Formerly known as twitter).
*It has been tested that If Illusionist (Transcended) hits an enemy who has the explosive attribute and are affected by the fragile status will not stun any nearby units upon death.
